name: sol_defi_lsd_2
description: Sandwich attack on liquid staking exchange-rate update draining ETH via instant deposit/withdraw
question: The source file in `source` implements a liquid staking exchange-rate repricing update together with an instant deposit and instant withdrawal mechanism priced off that exchange rate, allowing a user to deposit a large amount of ETH immediately before the repricing transaction and withdraw immediately after at the increased rate, without a withdrawal queue, time delay, or private/flashbots-protected repricing transaction to prevent this front-run/back-run sandwich from extracting protocol ETH risk-free.
criteria: A deposit() function mints shares at the current exchange rate and immediately allows the same block's withdraw()/redeem() to be called without any lock-up or queue delay
A repricing/rebase function updates the exchange rate variable based on accrued staking rewards and is a plain public/external transaction visible in the mempool with no MEV protection

withdraw() or redeem() computes ETH payout using the live exchange rate immediately after a reward update, with no minimum holding period or epoch-based accounting to prevent same-block deposit-then-withdraw
The contract allows unbounded instant ETH withdrawals tied directly to the just-updated exchange rate with no queue, cooldown, or batching mechanism separating deposits from the repricing event
